name: cybertriage
description: A desktop DFIR triage tool for academic demonstration.
author: Rashmi Anand

scripts.build:engine: python/venv/bin/python3 -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --onedir --contents-directory _internal --name CyberTriageEngine --distpath artifacts/engine --workpath artifacts/build --specpath artifacts/spec --strip --collect-all reportlab --collect-all Registry --hidden-import unicodecsv --hidden-import enum_compat --exclude-module sklearn --exclude-module scipy --exclude-module PIL --exclude-module Pillow --exclude-module matplotlib --exclude-module pandas --exclude-module tkinter --exclude-module pytest python/main.py
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.electron:dev: node scripts/check-dev-port.mjs && npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "cross-env BROWSER=none vite --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && electron ."
scripts.package:mac-arm64: npm run build:engine && npm run electron:build -- --mac dmg --arm64
